core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house in Oak Lane, Sevenoaks
core.listing:
A four-bedroom 1930s semi-detached house in Oak Lane with a 2021 kitchen/family room extension and a 2019 loft conversion with building regulations completion certificate. The property retains original stained-glass features in the front door and hall window.

The sitting room measures 4.55m x 3.70m into bay (14'11" x 12'2" into bay) and has a log burner. The dining room measures 3.60m x 3.40m (11'10" x 11'2"). The kitchen/family room, added in 2021, measures 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) and features an island, bi-fold doors to the garden and underfloor heating. A ground-floor shower room and utility occupy the former garage.

The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). Bedroom four, in the loft conversion completed in 2019, measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max) and has an en-suite. A family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approx. 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks station is approx. 0.8 miles away, with trains to London Bridge taking approx. 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. Broadband: FTTP, up to 900Mbps. Mobile signal: Good indoor and outdoor coverage. Parking: Driveway for two cars. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission.
